cost_source: Section 6, 2.9: about $2B FY2030-39; $0.2B a year permanent

title: Service coordinators in older renters' buildings
parameters: A service coordinator available to every federally assisted building where most households are headed by someone 62 or over; $150M a year more from FY2031 (decided, DEC-2026-11-09-25); referrals to Medicaid home care and HOU-12.04
eligibility: Federally assisted buildings mostly of older households
cost_source: Section 6, 2.9: about $1.35B FY2030-39; $0.15B a year permanent

title: Home-sharing grants
parameters: Grants to nonprofits matching older owners with low-rent tenants who help around the house; $30M a year FY2031-39 (decided, DEC-2026-11-09-25); report by 2035
eligibility: Older owners and home-sharing nonprofits
